invariants.rationale: If templateProps is used as an iterable, it should be an array if not null.
If parentProps is used as an iterable, it should be an array if not null.
templateProps and parentProps represent two different property sources.

invariants.expression: (parentProps == null && templateProps != null) || (parentProps != null && templateProps == null) || (parentProps != null && templateProps != null)
invariants.rationale: At least one of parentProps or templateProps is provided, as otherwise merged result would be null.
If templateProps is not null, its size should be non-negative.
